code.git_head: 800c53b (branch feat/v2.2-simulation-perception; working tree dirty with parallel teammates' uncommitted work - no commits are made by this task)
code.label_converter_note: the converter currently writes model-canvas normalised coordinates; this protocol's datasets are built with the source-normalised inverse (outputs/landmark_train/scripts/build_yolo_dataset.py) until evaltool fixes it

data.split_note: HN2 GT_UNOBSERVABLE frames are excluded from the 2x2 and from training loss; HN1 verified confuser negatives are empty labels (true negatives)

protocol.warmup_rule: no early stopping, no abort and no 'joint<0.60 => failed' verdict during warmup; validation metrics are logged only
protocol.checkpoint_candidates: last.pt + best.pt (ultralytics fitness) + save_period every 5 epochs; each candidate evaluated on val with evaltool scripts/evaluate_landmark_yolo.py
protocol.seed_selection_rule: compare seeds on validation only: highest val joint narrow-primary, tie-break lower validation FP, then lower seed; report all seeds including worst
protocol.threshold_freeze: on the selected checkpoint using validation outputs only: tau_conf = smallest score with val identity precision >= 0.95; tau_det = det score floor giving val presence precision >= 0.95; tau_margin from the multi-candidate subset; tau_px from 3*blind-annotation keypoint noise (>= 3 px) and never below annotation noise 2.236 px; tau_iou = 0.3 diagnostic; all frozen before final and recorded with the val metrics that justify them
protocol.final_protocol: lead runs the sealed final pool exactly once after freeze; no retraining, no threshold change, no rerun; a new evaluation needs new sealed data and a new pre-registration

hard_abort_conditions: annotation QA failure or leakage discovered
validation metric decreasing for 3 consecutive evaluations and below 0.40 after warmup
export path proven impossible for the intended deployment

measured.tolerance: if measured wall time exceeds the time box, run seed 0 first and add seeds 1/2 only if the remaining budget allows; the worst seed is still reported

known_deltas_from_upstream: ultralytics 8.2.0 x numpy 2.4 is not usable (np.trapz removed in numpy 2.4) -> numpy pinned to 1.26.4

evaltool landmark_yolo label export writes model-canvas normalised coordinates; overfit with those labels is INVALID (loss does not decrease). Datasets here use source-normalised labels and the convention was verified with the ultralytics loader (max delta 0.0003 px)
pilot runs 20 epochs, i.e. entirely inside warmup_epochs=15; its val numbers are an early snapshot
pilot uses the HN-merged val (134 frames). Final threshold freezing must use the frozen v3 val revision; any val change is recorded here before use
